meta_description: Done-for-you partner ops for B2B SaaS so referral and implementation partners actually create pipeline.
for_whom: For B2B SaaS teams with signed referral or implementation partners but no real weekly partner-ops rhythm
hero_headline: Turn signed partners into sourced pipeline without founders babysitting the channel
hero_subheadline: PartnerPipeline Desk runs the weekly partner cadence for B2B SaaS teams so referrals get chased, co-sell calls get prepped, and inactive partners stop disappearing in a spreadsheet.
credibility_line: Works inside your CRM, partner sheet, or inbox. Partner-approved messaging only. We run the operating cadence, not your commercial negotiation.
pain_paragraph: Most SaaS partner programs do not fail because the idea is bad. They fail because nobody owns the weekly follow-through after the agreement gets signed. Referred deals sit untouched, good partners stop hearing from you, and founders end up doing random partner chasing between customer calls. PartnerPipeline Desk turns that vague channel effort into a simple weekly operating system.
before: Your partner list lives in a spreadsheet, a CRM field, and someone's memory
Signed partners only hear from you when a deal is already slipping
Referral opportunities go stale because nobody owns follow-up, next steps, or co-sell prep
You cannot tell which partners are active, trainable, or quietly dead
after: Every partner sits in a clear tier with next step, cadence, and owner
New referrals get chased quickly instead of dying in inboxes
Important partner calls get a short co-sell brief so your team shows up prepared
You get a weekly partner health report showing active partners, stuck deals, and what to fix
offer_summary: A done-for-you partner ops desk for B2B SaaS: we maintain the partner roster, run the weekly touch cadence, follow up on referred opportunities, prep co-sell notes, and give you a simple scorecard so the channel actually moves.
included: Setup for one partner roster with agreed tiers, partner tags, and health statuses
Weekly partner touch cadence across email, CRM tasks, and optional shared tracker updates
Referral and deal-reg follow-up with next-step logging and fast escalation of hot opportunities
Short co-sell briefs for key partner calls or referred opportunities
Weekly partner scorecard with sourced opportunities, inactive partners, blockers, and recommended next actions
Starter pilot for one existing partner list or one stale referral pipeline
excluded: Acting as your quota-carrying partner rep or closing deals on your behalf
Negotiating commercial terms, contracts, or commission disputes
Building a partner portal or full PRM from scratch
Cold outbound to net-new partners unless separately scoped
process: Fit call: confirm partner type, partner count, current referral flow, and who approves messaging or partner offers
Setup: clean the partner roster, define tiers and health rules, lock the weekly cadence, and create the scorecard
Run the desk: follow up on partner leads, log partner touches, prep co-sell notes, and escalate anything hot fast
Weekly review: you get a clear partner health snapshot, sourced pipeline updates, stale partner risks, and next actions
Refine: tighten partner segments, improve enablement prompts, and double down on the partners that actually move deals
pricing_details: Starter covers one partner roster, one follow-through workflow, and up to 25 active partners or 10 active partner-sourced opportunities. Higher-volume plans start at $2,500/mo.
guarantee_line: If the pilot does not give you a clearly cleaner partner roster and weekly operating rhythm than what you have now, do not continue.

faq.q: How do you access partner and deal data safely?
faq.a: We use least-privilege access only: usually a CRM seat, shared inbox, partner spreadsheet, or exported reports. No contract-signing authority, no billing access, and no messages sent outside your approved rules.

faq.q: What needs to be in place before starting?
faq.a: You need an existing list of partners or referred opportunities, one person who can approve partner messaging, and a basic definition of what counts as an active partner. Messy data is fine; we can start with a spreadsheet.

Included: partner roster cleanup, weekly touch cadence, referral follow-up, co-sell prep, and weekly reporting. Excluded: quota-carrying sales, negotiating partner contracts, building a PRM, or recruiting entirely net-new partners by default.
Usually 2-5 business days. We review the current partner list, define the cadence and escalation rules, then start with either stale partners or the next live batch of referred opportunities.

faq.q: How long do you retain partner and opportunity data?
faq.a: Only as long as needed for active follow-through and the agreed reporting window. We can work inside a fixed retention period and export final notes back into your system before deleting working files.

trust_basics_line: You keep control of partner strategy, pricing, and commercial commitments. We run the weekly follow-through so the partner channel stops looking bigger on paper than it is in reality.
